turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mr. Reddy? I am Ananya from the Chennai City Police community outreach team.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy speaking. Is everything alright? Why are you calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Everything is fine, sir. We are just making awareness calls to senior citizens about the rise in digital fraud in our city.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, I see. My son told me about these things, but I get very confused with the phone apps.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is exactly why we are calling. Please remember that no police officer or bank official will ever ask for your OTP or PIN over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But what if there is a problem with my account? Like last month I had a transfer of twenty five thousand rupees that was delayed.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Even then, sir, the bank will never ask you to share your password or Aadhaar number to fix a transaction.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. Some people call me saying they are from the head office and ask for these things.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Those are scammers, Mr. Reddy. If anyone asks for a code or money to solve a problem, please hang up immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will keep that in mind. Thank you for warning me, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome, sir. Just stay alert and do not share any private details with strangers.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I understand now. Thank you for the call.
